paragraphs: R' Simai, or Simon, his son — Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, end of section 17; Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “His son” refers naturally to Kosi, the name in the heading. Simai and Simon are given as alternative forms.

The Mandelbaum digital text of Pesikta DeRav Kahana, end of section 17, has R' Simon bar R' Koi; the Torat Emet digital text of Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:6 has Rabbi Simon ben Kuzit. Hyman’s Kosi/Kozot and Simai/Simon alternatives are retained separately. The abbreviated title before Simai remains R', without transferring Simon’s locally attested full title to the alternative or admitting a paternal identity.
